messages.author: 49e107cb0f8a3d27
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Variational Inference in CmdStan 2.7
parts:
Hi Rick,

An explanation of the interface for variational inference can be found in the CmdStan manual, e.g., Section 2.3:
http://mc-stan.org/interfaces/cmdstan.html

Hope that helps.

Dustin
